basic_profile.bio: I'm a 41-year-old documentary filmmaker based in Kyoto, Japan. I moved here over a decade ago and have been combining my love for storytelling and exploration ever since. I teach part-time at a local university, sharing my passion for film and media with students. In my free time, I'm either hiking through Japan's stunning landscapes, experimenting with new camera techniques, or diving into a good sci-fi strategy game like Stellaris. I'm single, and my evenings are typically spent in front of my computer from 7 PM to midnight, while my mornings are dedicated to film shoots or preparation.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Master's degree in Film Production from a university in California and have been involved in the indie film scene for over 15 years. My expertise lies in crafting compelling narratives and utilizing visually striking imagery to enhance storytelling. I've self-taught a lot about the cultural nuances of Japan and often incorporate this into my work.
